issues.description: Contextual ambiguity regarding whether viewing available services requires authentication. The resolution states the system requires authentication, but service catalogs are traditionally publicly viewable by unauthenticated visitors.
issues.suggested_question: Can unauthenticated visitors view available services, or must a user first register and log in to view services?

issues.description: Slash conjunction ambiguity in 'salon staff/admins'. It is unclear whether 'staff' and 'admin' are distinct roles with differing access levels for appointments and services, or treated as an interchangeable single role.
issues.suggested_question: Are 'salon staff' and 'admins' separate roles with distinct permissions for managing appointments, services, and customer records?

issues.description: Modal ambiguity in 'can pay online'. It is unclear whether online payment is optional (with in-person payment also permitted) or mandatory to finalize the appointment booking.
issues.suggested_question: Is online payment mandatory at the time of booking, or is in-person payment at the salon supported as an alternative?

issues.description: Semantic ambiguity regarding cancellation scope and financial state. 'Customers can cancel appointments' does not specify time constraints or the resulting financial state for appointments already paid online.
issues.suggested_question: Does cancelling an appointment trigger an automated refund for online payments, and is there a cut-off window after which cancellations are disallowed?
